briefing.headline: DeepSeek R2 launch intensifies US-China frontier model race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has entered a new phase of accelerated model releases and compute buildouts, with Chinese labs closing the gap on US leaders. Regulatory pressure is mounting while investment remains robust across infrastructure and safety tools.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview with improved reasoning chains while Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus achieved new safety benchmarks. DeepSeek released R2, Meta advanced Llama 4 training, and xAI expanded Grok cluster capacity.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems while red-team reports highlight persistent multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reported record AI chip orders while energy constraints slow European expansion plans.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will Chinese labs achieve parity with US frontier models by end of 2027 or will export controls maintain a decisive lead?
